data.name: Furgeson
data.long_meaning: The name Furgeson is derived from the Old English word 'Furus,' meaning 'deer' or 'man.' The 'son of' suffix indicates that this name was given to someone whose father bore this name. In the Christian context, the name may evoke the image of the deer that approached the infant Jesus in the biblical story of the Nativity.
